card.name: Word before a patient group
card.fires_on: The word just before a named group of people: 'black' or 'African-American' before boys, babies or patients, and 'in' after 'have been reported' before patients or individuals.

card.writes: It seems to push the next word toward a group noun such as boys or patients, but the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the text names which people were affected, such as black boys or patients on a drug.
